# independent-netdevs: every socket is its own netdev (Qualcomm IPQ807x
# class, driver nss-dp): lan1-lan4 and wan each have a device link, no
# DEVTYPE, iflink == ifindex, and their label under device/of_node/label (no
# own of_node). There is no switch conduit. lan1 is administratively down, so
# carrier, speed and duplex cannot be read. wan (2.5 Gb/s) is bridged into
# LAN. Noise: bonding_masters (a regular file), the gre0 (type 778) / gretap0 /
# erspan0 (type 1, iflink 0, down) tunnels the kernel creates, miireg
# (type 0), the bridge and five wireless interfaces.
#
# Format: see loadTree in ports_test.go.

-- etc/board.json --
{
	"model": {
		"id": "example,independent-netdevs",
		"name": "Example per-port-netdev router"
	},
	"led": {
		"wan_port_link": {
			"name": "WAN-PORT-LINK",
			"type": "netdev",
			"device": "wan",
			"mode": "link_2500"
		}
	},
	"network": {
		"lan": {
			"ports": [
				"lan1",
				"lan2",
				"lan3",
				"lan4"
			],
			"protocol": "static"
		},
		"wan": {
			"device": "wan",
			"protocol": "dhcp"
		}
	}
}

-- sys/class/net/bonding_masters --

-- sys/class/net/br-lan/ --
type=1
ifindex=11
iflink=11
flags=0x1003
carrier=1
carrier_changes=3
operstate=up
speed=2500
duplex=unknown
address=02:00:00:00:03:46
mtu=1500
uevent=DEVTYPE=bridge\nINTERFACE=br-lan\nIFINDEX=11
bridge/forward_delay=1500
brif/lan2
brif/lan3
brif/lan4
brif/phy0-ap0
brif/phy0-ap1
brif/phy0-ap2
brif/phy1-ap0
brif/phy1-ap1
brif/wan
lower_lan2
lower_lan3
lower_lan4
lower_phy0-ap0
lower_phy0-ap1
lower_phy0-ap2
lower_phy1-ap0
lower_phy1-ap1
lower_wan
